[Hero Token Exchanger]
If you fought Morocc
and collected
Hero Tokens,
I can exchange them with a special ring for you.
Do you want to take a look at my ring?

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Your pack has a lot of items,
Please come again after arrange it!
Ring description
Exchange with the ring.
End conversation.

[Hero Token Exchanger]
This Hero Ring
may not
look
impressive,

[Hero Token Exchanger]
but take it to
Expert Enchanter Byrnes,
and he can Enchant
all 4 sockets in it
and bring out
its latent abilities.

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring
can aid you
in subjugating
Morocc.
Any more questions?

- Hero Ring -
^006400A ring made for warriors^000000
^006400on the quest to defeat Morocc..^000000
^006400When Enchanted,^000000
^006400it lends its owner^000000
^006400the power to confront Morocc.^000000
^006400Clas: Accessory/DEF: 0^000000
^006400Weight: 20/Required Level: 160^000000
^006400Slot: 0/Equip To: All Jobs^000000

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring requires
30 Hero Tokens
for the exchange.
Do you want to exchange?
Previous menu.
Exchange 30 Hero Tokens.

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Think
again.

[Hero Token Exchanger]
^006400Hero Token^000000
is given to
those who bravely fought Morocc.
You don't have
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000,
and therefore I can't assist you.

[Hero Token Exchanger]
I'll exchange
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000
with 1 ^006400Hero Ring^000000.
Anything else?

[Hero Token Exchanger]
One day
you'll find yourself
in need of Hero Ring.

[Byrnes]
Have you heard of Hero Ring? Only true heroes deserve to possess that magnificent ring, and I've been waiting for one.
What can I do for you?
Enchant Hero Ring.
Reset Enchantments on Hero Ring.
Cancel.

[Byrnes]
I can Enchant only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to Enchant?
Left
Right

[Byrnes]
Please equip the Hero Ring that you want to enchant.

[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't Enchant anything else.

[Byrnes]
A fully enchanted Hero Ring cannot be enchanted any further.

[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot {0}?

[Byrnes]
Enchantment completed!

[Byrnes]
To reset Enchantments on your Hero Ring, I need 3 Hero Tokens.

[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.

[Byrnes]
I can reset only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to reset?
Left
Right

[Byrnes]
You first have to equip the item to reset its Enchantment status.

[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't reset anything else.

[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.

[Byrnes]
Your Hero Ring is currently in a state without enchantment.

[Byrnes]
Initialization completed.
